reviews.text:
My pups love this location for daycare and training. We didn't have the best experience at the other Urban Pooch location but this location has smaller dog groups for daycare.

What makes this location and the training facility stand out is the staff. I hope the management here appreciates their staff because I have seen some of my favorites leave. It's made me not want to sign up for one-on-one training because the trainer I was working with left, and those classes are expensive to restart. It's not easy taking care of pups at a place that is more boutique than others and so will have a more difficult clientele. Some of the kindest people work here like Rebekah, Jorrah, Krissi, Tristan, etc and should be appreciated.

Urban Pooch made it possible for us to wash our very reactive dog. They are kind, compassionate, helpful, and knowledgeable.
I don’t know what we would do without them!

I have worked with dogs for over 20 years and seen numerous dog training and enrichment facilities and Urban Pooch is fantastic!  I wanted to set up private training lessons for Thor, my Aussie Shepherd mix, and he loves enrichment time!  They were so responsive to my needs. Thor loved his agility session with Rebekah, she is great!  I will be scheduling nose work training too.  They also have boarding, grooming, and more! If you want excellent customer service along with great options for training and enrichment, go to Urban Pooch, you will not be disappointed!

Urban Pooch Training and Fitness on Damen has been Maximus’ happy place since he was a pup.  From training to daycare to agility courses and grooming- he’s been eager to attend, happily content when he comes home and his learning is astounding.  Shout out to Ali his groomer, Krissy his bestie counselor and Robin Taylor his agility trainer. Everyone at Urban Pooch has been wonderful and makes mommy feel better knowing he’s well cared for and loved. 💟🐺🐾🙏🏻
Thank you, Hannah, for the 5-star review! We’re thrilled you had a great experience and appreciate your support. We look forward to welcoming you back soon.
Great facility, great staff, and great programs. The nosework class led by Sue is an absolute gem!

Our 5-year old lab loves Urban Pooch Training and Fitness Center and their amazing staff counselors!  We began with their puppy training class at 8 weeks old and then at 6 months started her in enrichment daycare a few times a week and haven't stopped. As an active young lab, she needs activity and stimulation, and Urban Pooch provides that and so much more. She would not be as well behaved if it wasn't for the Enrichment Daycare staff. She has also participated weekly in their Sports & Fitness Academy for 3 years and absolutely adores the training and instructor. We completely trust the team at Urban Pooch Training & Fitness Center to take the best care of our little girl!

I love Urban Pooch! I’ve been taking my dog there since he was a puppy. We’ve done obidence classes and agility classes, and everything has been very fun. They are such a great resource for his reactivity. He’s improved so much since we started taking classes and private lessons. I love working with Pamela! She is the best!

We had a great experience with this training center! We struggled for a long time with a very reactive dog, and the specialists at Urban Pooch were the first ones who truly helped us understand our dog's needs and work through the challenges we were facing.
A huge shout-out to Pamela and Sharon! The reactivity classes, and especially the Reactivity Club afterwards, are incredible and not something you can find at every training center. They've made a huge difference for us.

We're so grateful for all the help and highly recommend Urban Pooch to anyone looking for quality training. They offer an amazing variety of classes and activities to help you train, bond with your dog, and continue learning together.
Andrea, thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back soon.

Enrolled my 7 year old pit bull for the levels program in hopes of learning better leash walking. I cannot believe how quickly our walks improved! We can navigate so many distractions and obstacles with ease including walking with a loose leash past other dogs who are barking/ pulling/ lunging toward us. We’ve learned a bunch of other really beneficial skills as well that have made places like the dog beach and dog friendly places so much more enjoyable. Our pup LOVES attending class and is always eager to attend. The instructors are fantastic and we’re excited to start level 4 and earn the canine good citizen certificate.
I Love the classes and the staff. My dog and I  have taken levels and nose work with Sue Sentowski. She is a great teacher.  The facilities and store are awesome. Staff is so friendly and helpful.

My dog Jax and I love Urban Pooch. Jax is 4yr old now and we have been at Urban Pooch for one and a half years now. I wish I had known about it when Jax was a puppy!

We are working on focus in the presence of distraction in the Pooch in Progress class with Pamela Davis and the Levels program with Pamela, Sharon Cierniak and other trainers. Jax is very excitable. He gets excited when the trainer approaches and sometimes barks excitedly. I especially like Pamela’s assessments of Jax and attention to what would work for Jax.

My pup and I love the classes and people at Urban Pooch! Pamela’s reactive dog club has been so helpful in teaching me about my pup’s behaviors and different skills to best advocate for her. We also love all of the agility instructors, especially Ashley. They are so great at giving my girl the accommodations she needs to thrive in class. My pup absolutely loves going to her classes each week!

Urban Pooch has been fantastic for my pup, Lilo! We’ve been regulars since she first started as a small puppy in the puppy paw star academy and now she loves the enrichment daycare and we are members of the levels classes. Lilo is a one year old golden so she has A LOT of energy! We loved attending the pooch in progress classes with Pamela where she helped us learn how to focus around other pups and enabled us to really make progress once we went back to the levels classes. We plan to stay members for a long time yet to keep learning and training and of course having fun at daycare. I’m so grateful our vet recommended Urban Pooch!

I have been training nosework at Urban pooch with 3 different dogs over many years now. Sue S is the best! From starting a puppy to working with our aging senior dogs, she challenges us all. Thank you Urban Pooch for all you offer our city pups!

We’ve been taking our dog to Urban Pooch ever since he was a puppy (he’s four now). We started with their ‘Levels’ program, which starts with puppy basics and climbs through increasingly more advanced skills that help them navigate the human urban world. The levels classes are engaging and fun for dogs and human’s alike, teaching the pups how to handle the real world (and more importantly, train the humans how to help their dogs in difficult situations). We then moved into more enrichment programs like nose work classes (think like how a police dog is trained to sniff out and locate items) to agility sport classes (jumping and running through a defined course). All these programs have visibly built confidence in our dog, and strengthened his bond with us. He absolutely loves all the classes, and so do we!  We’ve experienced just about all the trainers over the years, and all of them are incredibly professional, engaging, and helpful with any questions you have.

Finally, their store has just everything a dog owner would need, and our dog knows that he’s rewarded with a treat he picks out after a successful class.  Occasionally, after a late night class, the retail store will be closed. The disappointment on our dog’s face is visible (see attached photo).

Urban Pooch on Damen is awesome! We’ve done Puppy Pawstars, Pooch Academy, and Enrichment Day are here, and all were just what our dog needed. The trainers and team are incredible (shout out to Marta and Ellie!), and we’ve been so so pleased with the positive it’s all had on our dog. Planning to try agility classes next. Can’t recommend them highly enough!

Urban Pooch Training and Fitness Center has been incredible for our dog. He's a regular at Enrichment Daycare (Jorma and Krissi made him at home from his very first day) and is also enrolled in Pooch Academy. We've seen a huge improvement in his socialization and his behavior from the regular training and fun with his buddies. We've also done one-on-one training sessions with Marta, who we highly recommend. Sharon and Olivia have worked with our pup regularly in Pooch Academy and their report cards let us know what to work on at home. Can't say enough good things about this place and the care, attention, and support they give to pups (and their people!)

UPTFC has been an incredible part of my dog’s life for almost four years. From enrichment daycare to training and grooming, every experience has been consistently outstanding. The team truly understands each dog as an individual and interacts with them in a way that makes them feel safe, engaged, and loved. Their creative theme days are unmatched—always thoughtful, fun, and clearly designed with the dogs’ happiness in mind. Ali does an amazing groom every single time, and all of the staff are friendly, helpful, and wonderfully accommodating. I couldn’t ask for a better place. Love everything about UPTFC!

We love Urban Pooch training!  The flexible Levels classes helped us and our reactive rescue dog build skills and gain confidence.  And in Tricks Star class  Sharon is helping us communicate better in the most fun way.

We love Urban Pooch Training & Fitness sooooo much! Sharon’s Tricks and Agility classes are wonderful and our favorite! Enrichment daycare and grooming have also always been great & my pup, Samson, is a graduate of the Levels obedience program. I cannot say enough about how amazing the Levels program was for him, and it’s also where he first met Sharon who has by far been his favorite teacher! Urban Pooch is seriously the best, it’s helped Samson be his best self, and his tail is always wagging even if it’s just for a nail trim!

I started the LEVELS training classes with my dog Penne earlier this year. Every day, I ask if she wants to go to class, she gets the zoomies and cannot wait to get to the facility. She loves all the trainers; Pamela, Sharon, Marta, Ellie, Olivia, Lyn - she has learned a ton with each one. We also did a fitness 1-on-1 with Rebekah and I was very impressed I cannot recommend them more!

Donnie has been going to Urban Pooch since he was a baby in puppy paw star. He has done agility classes but his favorite is enrichment day care. They do awesome activities, parties  and they truly love our pups!!!!
My dog Caoimhe loves tricks class  she has so much fun and has learned a lot
Sharon Cierniak is a great trainer!   We attend her agility 2 class but she is so helpful with all kinds of training issues!  She is our favorite!

I’ve been attending Agility training classes with Sharon Cierniak here for more than 18 months. Sharon is a great instructor, and the experience has been very rewarding for our entire family. Our dog has come such a long way since we first started — learning new skills, running the course with increasing confidence and proficiency, and basking in praise (and patience) from his instructor and classmates. It’s been a great way to strengthen our pet-to-pet-parent bond, and something we look forward to every week.

Urban Pooch has been a great experience for me, my husband, and our dog. Everyone is organized, friendly, and the classes are run really well. I’m so glad they were recommended to us.

Our agility instructor, Sharon, is wonderful. She has years of experience, and it really shows. She’s incredibly knowledgeable, but what I appreciate most is how she teaches the people as much as the dogs. She has a great sense of humor, is very patient, and makes learning fun. She keeps the class moving so we get a lot accomplished every session and definitely feel like we’re getting our money’s worth.

I would highly recommend Urban Pooch and Sharon to anyone looking for agility training.

We enjoy taking classes at Urban Pooch because of the knowledgeable instructors who provide confidence and guide rails for you and your dog. We started taking socialization classes when Mabel was 11 weeks old. We then took Puppy Fundamentals, Puppy, Agility, and started their Levels Program as Mabel worked toward the completion of her Canine Good Citizenship certification. We are currently enrolled in a Tricks Class that feels like a capstone program for bringing all skills together.

During these programs, we worked with highly skilled instructors who are passionate about their work and gentle with people who are learning to manage their new pet. All of the instructors are amazing, but we particularly enjoyed taking classes with Marta Adamek who is patient and kind and instilled confidence in both me and Mabel. Sharon Cierniak is disciplined and focused. Sharon sets the bar high and helps you get over it.

We are incredibly grateful for the team at Urban Pooch. They are a fantastic resource that helps improve the lives of people and their pets.

I’ve been bringing my dog here for the past three years, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience\. The trainers are knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely care about helping both dogs and their owners succeed\. A special thank you to Sharon and Pamela for their guidance and encouragement every step of the way\. The Levels Program gave my dog a strong foundation in obedience and helped shape her into the wonderful, happy, well\-behaved dog she is today.
Pamela at puppy fundamentals is so knowledgeable and I love all the play time!

My wife, our pup Hazel, and I LOVE Urban Pooch. It was our first experience in Chicago with boarding, daycare, and classes and we have been so impressed. Hazel loves her time at Urban Pooch and has especially loved working with Pam on Pooch in Progress and Levels. We recently did the Trick Star classes with Sharon and had a blast. She was engaged and also loved learning and performing haha. She’s a young dog with lots of energy and her trainers have been so patient and kind. Would recommend any class based on what your dog loves. We hope to take many more in the future. Also, they have lots of themed days at daycare and the pictures are so cute!!!

My pup and I love our classes at Urban Pooch.  We have been in Sharon’s classes for almost 2 years.  Her expertise and teaching style is unmatched!  I’ve become better at handling and training my dog because of her and it doesn’t hurt that my doggo LUVS her!  Really great experience!

Daycare, training, nail trims and the shop - we’ve loved everything we’ve tried but the best part is always the staff!!

We’ve been bringing our dog to Urban Pooch for the enrichment daycare for over a year now. They’re FANTASTIC. Studies show us how important enrichment activities are for dogs. Moose comes home mellow vs anxious and we can tell his manners have been growing from their training days and puzzle days. Plus, he’s much more confident in new situations and walking on new textures. He’s benefited so much from just daycare alone. We also try to bring him in for training too and the classes have been great.

And the bonus? The themed photo shoots!

I’m starting to think our dog likes the Urban Pooch staff more than he likes us… 😂 Every time he goes, he has the time of his life and comes home happily exhausted for the rest of the day. The staff are so kind, the enrichment activities look like so much fun, and the pictures they send are ridiculously cute. We couldn’t ask for a better doggy daycare. If our pup could leave this review himself, we’re pretty sure he’d give it an enthusiastic two paws up! 🐾💛

I love the trainer Robin for agility.  She is incredibly patient with us and our pups
We also like the dog groomer at Ravenswood, she has been grooming several of our flat coats properly for years. The basic obedience class with Lynn was a great start for our crazy pup

I've been taking my pups to Urban Pooch for over 12 years. Over the years we've taken their Levels, agility and nose work class as well as some of their workshops. My dogs absolutely LOVE going to Urban Pooch! Trainers Sue and Robin make classes fun and challenging and the entire staff is pleasant and helpful. Urban Pooch is by far the best place we've ever trained!

I’ve been taking my pup here for over five years now and I have seen this amazing place through undergo many changes— but one thing has remained the same and that is the staff’s commitment to taking the best care of my baby. Genuinely, being able to leave my girl with a trusted extended family like this team (you all know who you are), I don’t know what I would do without them. 🥰

The literal best place. Trainers are so good, facility is great, and best of all my dog is so happy to be there. The entire staff is incredible and fun and kind and creative and helpful and just truly the best!!
Thank you, Elyse, for the 5-star review! We’re thrilled you had a great experience and appreciate you!

We love Urban Pooch and have learned so much from every single trainer we have teamed with. We have participated in Puppy FUNdamentals, puppy play zone, and LEVELS classes, each offering valuable skills for our spunky little guy. Learning how to channel our pup’s energy has boosted his confidence and ultimately allowed for him to be included in more of our life experiences outside of class. We love their positive approaches for reinforcing behavior, sense of humor, collaboration, and creative opportunities to simulate real life experiences. Big thanks to Lyn, Sharon, Marta, Ellie, Pamela, Ashley, and Olivia! We cannot recommend the incredible team of trainers at Urban Pooch enough!

Always great, we've been going here for 4 years and the training and grooming services are top notch! Food and other pet items can be a bit overpriced but not terribly so. Our dog loves to visit and she recommends Urban Pooch with two paws up!

Our puppy went here for Paw Star Academy and for Sunday puppy socialization classes. Urban Pooch does a fantastic job helping your puppy in development, as well and my wife and I as pet owners who wanted to learn more about supporting his development. Can’t recommend them enough. Especially Ellie, who is now our pup’s best friend ❤️

My pooch, Winifred, has been going to Enrichment Daycare for almost 3 years now. She's treated like a queen there which gives me peace of mind during busy work weeks. My dog is not overly playful but still enjoys company, so I really appreciate that the play groups are smaller and based on energy levels. And the monthly themed parties are hilariously silly. Definitely recommend Urban Pooch services!
Nalah is always so excited on her daycare days!  Great staff that really care about the dogs.  Also offers a lot of different fun trainings (eg agility, nosework).
Thank you, Krystal, for the 5-star rating! We’re thrilled you had a great experience and appreciate your support. We look forward to serving you again soon.

Justus Joseph is an absolute joy to learn from. Her Dog Dance class at Urban Pooch is wonderfully encouraging, supportive, and genuinely fun—for both dogs and their humans. She has a rare ability to make everyone feel welcome, no matter their experience level, and she celebrates progress in a way that builds confidence and connection.

The class beautifully integrates playful tricks with popular music and light choreography, creating a free-flowing, creative experience that never feels rigid or intimidating. You can tell Justus truly cares about the relationship between dog and owner, and she fosters an atmosphere that’s upbeat, inclusive, and full of laughter.

If you’re looking for a class that blends training, creativity, and pure joy, Dog Dance with Justus is a total standout. Highly recommend. 🐾🎶
Thank you, John, for the 5-star review! We’re delighted you had a great experience and appreciate your support. We look forward to serving you again.
Ruthie loves her time in enrichment daycare! Grooming with Ali is the best, too.

My golden retriever Enzo loves Urban Pooch. He started going to the puppy training sessions early on and I’m convinced it helped him socialize and avoid separation anxiety.
After training, we have continued with enrichment daycare a few days a week. Then staff is amazing. They are great coaches and really care for the dogs. Enrichment consists of activities to stimulate them and to tire them out.  I can’t thank them enough for helping Enzo develop and grow.  It’s a great investment in your best four legged friend.

We love Urban Pooch! Buttercup started there in STAR puppy class over 7 years ago and since then, we've done it all...training, daycare (both locations), boarding, and grooming. Their staff is so friendly and give individualized care to the dogs. Their trainers are patient and keep it fun. Their scheduling and reservations websites are organized. Deb and Amber work magic grooming my doodle. Their treat and toy selection is high quality and the seasonal toys are so fun.  Buttercup is always dragging me inside and thinks they have the  best bully sticks in town.

Urban Pooch Enrichment DayCare is my go to for my senior pup. He loves going there! Great personalized attention, creative physical and mental exercises, and a safe, clean environment. Highly recommend!

Urban Pooch has been such a wonderful addition to our dog’s routine. Kip goes for enrichment daycare and supplemental training, and it has made a huge difference, especially during the winter months when getting enough stimulation can be a challenge. His socialization, confidence, and overall happiness have all noticeably improved.
The staff is incredible, and the front‑of‑house team is always so friendly and welcoming. Kip practically runs through the door every time. We’re so grateful for everything Urban Pooch provides and highly recommend them to anyone looking for high‑quality care and enrichment.

Amanda did some amazing work on Basal, my new best friend! He is only 5 lbs but a boy has to be a little teddy when he can.
Thanks so much!

We just took our dog for his first nose work class. Before the class even started, our dog was whining while he was in the crate getting settled in with a toy in the crate. This was his first time in a new environment. The trainer was clearly very annoyed and told us to bring a kong next time. We tried to explain that we have had our dog for 6 years and have tried to introduce a kong many times and that he has never showed any interest and that he is a bit neurotic and generally refuses to engage with toys or treats while in his crate. The trainer kept talking over us and would not listen or let us explain anything. She was very rude and dismissive. It was a terrible experience. When we signed up for the class, my partner explained some of his behaviors and they were assured that it wouldn't be a problem, but for the trainer it was definitely a problem. We left before the class and will not be back and will also not have our other dog attend a different class we had signed up for. This was an overwhelmingly negative experience for us.
The absolute best of the best !

We had pictures with Santa here today but our dogs LOVE the staff at both locations and have had great daycare and boarding experiences here.  Grateful to have a great resource with 24 hour staffing as an option so close to where we live!
We love Urban Pooch! Our pup loves the daycare program, the staff are so great to him. The booking process is easy and the team is communicative about our pup’s experience.
Urban Pooch is my pups happy place. She loves both facilities and is a happy camper when boarding at the Canine Life Center.
Great place for dogs!

Fantastic organization! We took our somewhat reactive rescue dog for the Pooch In Progress course and had a great experience. Everyone we worked with there was professional, kind, knowledgeable, and clearly loved dogs - especially the trainer, Pamela. We learned so much in the class and have seen real improvements with our dog.  There are a really nice variety of classes and activities to choose from in general.
Love this place.
Took my new puppy to their puppy agility class and it was so fun! It helped build my puppy’s confidence even with just one session! Highly recommend this class if you’ve got a wild one on your hands.
Thank you!

They cut up my dogs ear and hid it from me. I moved here from Madison, WI a few months ago and was looking for a new groomer for my elderly Bichon Frise (he’s almost 19!) He’s usually a very chill dog but as he’s gotten older he’s become a little more fidgety especially when talking him to new places. When I came to pick him up, the lady at the front desk told me that he had tried to bite the groomer which I was so surprised by because I had never heard of him doing that before over many years of taking him to many different groomers. When we got home, I noticed he was shaking his head a lot but he’s usually dramatic after getting a big haircut (somewhat like he’s embarrassed by his new look haha) so I thought nothing of it. He has big floppy ears and a few days later I check under it and he has a huge scab. So he was shaking his head in discomfort the whole time because his ear had been cut! I understand that mistakes happen and he’s an old dog with a new groomer but the fact that they hid this from me instead of even acknowledging it much less apologizing is extremely disappointing. Besides this, they honestly did a great job with the haircut so I would’ve come back but covering up injuring my dog is unacceptable.
Thank you!

We’ve really enjoyed our first treibball class! Ruby has always loved playing fetch, and treibball feels similar but more with more technique and challenges. With multiple balls, a goal to reach, and a focus on teamwork between us, it really gets her thinking. It’s been fun to tap into Ruby’s herding instincts, though I’m sure any dog would love it. As Ruby gets older, we’re grateful that treibball is active yet low impact. We also appreciate how Ashley makes practicing at home so easy with fun and creative homework ideas. Ruby has gained confidence and learned new commands—this class gets her moving and thinking all while having fun.
Thank you!
Thank you!
We’re So Glad your Pooch had a Great Experience! Thx for your Review!
Thank you!

The best place for training!
And their retail has everything you need: Food, treats & toys!
SHOP LOCAL!

We have been taking our pup here for a couple months. She is going through the levels program and have found it wonderful. The flexibility of different days, different trainers styles, and more than once a week has allowed her to learn so much more quickly that I experienced with my previous dog with once a week classes. I've enjoyed every single one of the trainers and they are very kind.  The store also has a great selection!

Best in the business for everything canines! Dan and Ed truly speak their passion for animals through their wonderful and professional staff. If you have a pooch in Chicago, check them out for daycare, boarding, grooming, retail, and more! 5/5 recommend!
They’re just the best and we love everyone at Urban Pooch. The love they have for dogs and their patience… I cannot express how lucky we feel to have found Urban Pooch!

I took my puppy there for puppy fundamentals
Class.. I was impressed with the attentiveness, professionalism,and cleanliness of the facility. They have good adult trainers..not kids. It is professionally run and I intend on taking another class there with my
Pup. Great job!!

We loved Reactive Dog 1 with Pamela and Coco and would highly recommend it. Our only regret is not taking this class sooner! We've seen a huge improvement in our dog's reactivity on walks- it's amazing how much of a difference the 6 weeks have made. Our dog seems happier and more confident on walks as well now that she has a better coping mechanism for when she sees another dog. I would say that our dog's reactivity is a 3-4 down from a 9-10, which has been a larger improvement than we thought possible! I cannot recommend this class enough to anyone with a reactive dog.

amazing staff and talent under the hood make this well oiled machine really cruise... It's obvious everyone is committed to the best experience. From the communication at the reception, great products that are well researched and top talent in the grooming area.
Thank you!
We are So Grateful for your Review! Thanks.
